service.description: The related image of a master piece for publishing: the large image as base64 and its public website URL (empty when the company has no website). imageBase64 is empty when the piece has no image.
All master content pieces of the owner with their images as a ZIP.

actions.script:
import groovy.json.JsonOutput import java.util.zip.ZipEntry import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream
ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream() ZipOutputStream zipOut = new ZipOutputStream(bytes) List rows = [] for (mc in pieces) { Map row = [pseudoId: mc.pseudoId, contentType: mc.contentType, pnpType: mc.pnpType, title: mc.title, body: mc.body, callToAction: mc.callToAction, targetUrl: mc.targetUrl, teaserMode: mc.teaserMode, ctaUrl: mc.ctaUrl, status: mc.status] def ref = mc.imageLocation ? ec.resource.getLocationReference(mc.imageLocation + 'large') : null if (ref?.getExists()) { byte[] img = ref.openStream().withCloseable { it.bytes } String ext = (img.length > 3 && (img[0] & 0xff) == 0x89 && img[1] == 0x50) ? 'png' : (img.length > 3 && img[0] == 0x47 && img[1] == 0x49) ? 'gif' : 'jpg' row.image = "images/${mc.pseudoId}.${ext}".toString() zipOut.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(row.image)) zipOut.write(img) zipOut.closeEntry() } rows.add(row) } zipOut.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry('masterContents.json')) zipOut.write(JsonOutput.prettyPrint(JsonOutput.toJson([masterContents: rows])).getBytes('UTF-8')) zipOut.closeEntry() zipOut.close() zip = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes.toByteArray()) fileName = "master-content-${ec.user.nowTimestamp.toLocalDateTime().toLocalDate()}.zip"

service.description: Turn one content idea into a ~500 word article in the house voice and delete the idea: the pasted text and the fetched article URL are both used as material. Creates a DRAFT MasterContent (contentType ARTICLE, teaser mode on) whose targetUrl is the website page the article goes to; the page itself is written when the piece is approved (approve#MasterContent), so nothing becomes public without a human. Adapting it per platform afterwards gives teasers that link to the article.

Give a piece its own article page under the hidden '_articles/' folder of the owner's website and turn teaser mode on: targetUrl becomes the page, so teasers that say "read the full article" link to the article. The previous targetUrl (e.g. a landing page) is kept as ctaUrl, the call-to-action link at the bottom of the page. The page is written on approval (publish#ArticlePage), right away when the piece is already approved. Does nothing when the piece has a page already.
